nodes.label: Docker Compose File-based Secrets Pattern
nodes.rationale: Secrets are mounted as files under /run/secrets via *_FILE env variables instead of plaintext env vars, isolating credentials from process environments and image layers.

nodes.label: Encrypted Offsite Backup Strategy (rclone crypt:eventanilla)
nodes.rationale: Backups are pushed to a client-side encrypted rclone crypt remote so the storage provider cannot read database dumps; daily mode keeps RPO small and restore-check verifies restorability.
